subject: Re: Demo request — GitOrg integration & webhook perms
messages:
From: Alyssa Morgan <alyssa@gitorg.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 2 Sep 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request — GitOrg -> Redwood integration questions

Hi Jordan,

We signed up for the self-serve trial and are looking to schedule a short demo to see how Redwood would fit into our GitOrg workflow. Primary use case: installing a Redwood GitHub app that can provide code-aware suggestions and repo-scoped embeddings for search. A few specific questions before we lock in time: 

- Do you support per-repo webhook filtering (we want to avoid noise from CI events)?
- Can the app be installed to an org with a mix of public and private repos and only grant access to a subset?
- Any guidance on data residency for embeddings generated from private repos?

We'd like a 30–45 minute call with an engineer and a product person. Our team is US Pacific (PDT) timezone — best times are 10am–1pm PT next week.

Thanks,
Alyssa Morgan
Product Manager, GitOrg
alyssa@gitorg.io

---
Attachment: trial-usage-screenshot.png (image/png, referenced)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Morgan <alyssa@gitorg.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 3 Sep 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — Demo slots and quick precall checklist

Hi Alyssa — thanks for signing up and for the clear list of questions. We're happy to run a 30–45 minute session with an engineer + product. Karthik (cc'd) will join for the technical deep-dive. Quick answers up front: 

- Yes, the GitHub app supports per-repo webhook filters and we can scope event types at install or via repo settings (we'll show the UI).
- The app supports org-wide install with per-repo permissions; customers commonly grant read-only to specific repos and exclude others.
- Embeddings for private repos can be kept in-region; we support region pinning for storage and allow customers to opt into ephemeral caching. We'll cover the tradeoffs.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 2028-09-05 10:00–10:45
- Tue 2028-09-05 11:30–12:15
- Wed 2028-09-06 10:30–11:15

Or you can pick any time on my calendar: https://meet.redwood.ai/s/jordan-30

Prep for the call: please forward any short list of repos you'd like us to reference, and whether you want SSO or SAML discussed. I've attached a short demo guide that explains installer scopes and common architecture diagrams.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
SDR, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.ai
---
Attachment: redwood-demo-guide.pdf (application/pdf)

Also: we'll send a short list of three repos and a brief description of our desired search/triage behavior before the call. We do want to cover SSO (okta) and any required permissions for org installs.

Thanks,
Alyssa
